note: Observed draw rate versus effective Elo rating gap, from replaying post-1980 internationals through EloConfig.DEFAULT (the same replay the CLI --draw-curve prints). gap is the lower edge of each 50-point bin (600 is the top, open-ended bin). observed is the raw draw share in that bin, n its match count; shipped is DrawModel.DRAW_RATE_BY_GAP, the lightly smoothed table the Elo-side model actually uses. This is the Elo baseline and title simulator's draw component, not the production Dixon-Coles draw mechanism, which derives draws from the scoreline distribution.
